OID=$(curl -s "$BASE/api/instances?dbType=OSS" -H "$H" | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print([i["id"] for i in json.load(sys.stdin)["data"] if i["name"]=="oss-noschema"][0])')
echo "--- OSS null schemaName vs live mock root (expect 状态码 200)"
curl -s -X POST $BASE/api/instances/$OID/ping -H "$H" | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["data"])'
echo "--- OSS with schemaName bucket (expect 404)"
BID=$(curl -s -X POST $BASE/api/instances -H "$H" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name":"oss-bucket","dbType":"OSS","host":"127.0.0.1:9000","schemaName":"bucket"}' | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["data"]["id"])')
curl -s -X POST $BASE/api/instances/$BID/ping -H "$H" | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["data"])'
